problem_solution.title: Why Paper Notebooks Fail Nepali Farms & How Digital Khetala Solves It
problem_solution.description: For generations, Nepali farm owners, tea garden managers, and village labor contractors have recorded khetala in pocket registers. Here is why handwritten registers cause financial loss and how Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab eliminates wage disputes permanently.

items.title: Monsoon Rain, Damaged Notebooks & Device Loss
items.problem: Paper notebooks get soaked in sudden monsoon downpours, smeared with garden mud, or misplaced in fields. If a physical register is lost or a phone is damaged, months of labor attendance and advance records vanish.
items.solution: Local Drift SQLite keeps working instantly without network, while Cloud Firestore automatically synchronizes your household records upon connection, protecting you from lost paper registers or damaged phones.

items.title: Payday Advance (पेश्की) Disputes
items.problem: Workers routinely take cash advances before Dashain, Tihar, or during family emergencies. When wage settlement arrives weeks later, landowners and workers frequently argue over how much was paid versus how much was earned.
items.solution: Every payment is recorded as whole rupees with timestamp, payment type (regular wage, advance peshki, or recovery), and an unalterable audit log. Running balances update instantly on the worker's ledger.

items.title: Fractional Calculations & Tea Picking by Weight
items.problem: Tea picking is compensated by weight (e.g. 17.5 kg at रू 26.50/kg) while land plowing or weeding is paid by partial days (0.5 day). Manual pocket-calculator math produces rounding discrepancies that create mutual distrust.
items.solution: Exact integer paisa arithmetic (1 NPR = 100 paisa) combined with arbitrary-precision decimal quantity calculations using BigInt half-up rounding. Zero IEEE-754 floating point errors.

items.title: Verbal Disagreements During Final Wage Settlement
items.problem: When settling season-end wages, reading handwritten scribbles with crossed-out lines creates tension and accusations of unfair accounting between farm owners and laborers.
items.solution: Generate a clean, printable A4 PDF Worker Statement with 25-row pagination, itemized daily tasks, rates, payments, and running balances. Hand a printed copy or share it directly via WhatsApp.

items.title: Gregorian (AD) Calendar Mismatch
items.problem: Standard international accounting and finance apps only support the Gregorian (January-December) calendar. Nepali agricultural cycles, festival wages, and village contracts operate strictly in Bikram Sambat (वि.सं.).
items.solution: Built from the ground up with native Bikram Sambat (BS) date picker, bilingual Nepali month headers (Baisakh to Chaitra), and dual BS/AD date formatting powered by nepali_utils.

features.title: 8 Core Verified Systems Built for Real Agricultural Conditions
features.description: Every feature is implemented in production code, verified with 351 automated tests, and tuned for instant performance on budget Android smartphones in rural Nepal.

list.title: 1. Local-First Drift SQLite Engine
list.summary: Every worker, attendance entry, rate override, and cash payment is stored locally on your device in a high-performance SQLite database with full foreign key constraints (`PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`).
bullet_points: Works reliably in remote fields without cellular network or internet connectivity
Sub-millisecond read and write latency even with thousands of entries
Automated Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) preventing data loss during battery drain or sudden phone shutdown
Immediate local persistence with background queueing for automatic cloud synchronization

list.title: 2. Exact Integer Paisa Arithmetic
list.summary: In Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab, money is never stored as floating-point numbers (`double`). Every monetary figure is tracked as integer paisa (1 Nepalese Rupee = 100 paisa).
bullet_points: Eliminates cumulative IEEE-754 precision drift common in standard spreadsheet apps
Decimal quantities (e.g., 23.75 kg) use BigInt unscaled arithmetic with half-up rounding to the nearest paisa
Payments and opening balances enforce clean whole-rupee input for fast field operation
Net balances are dynamically calculated on-the-fly from active records, preventing balance drift

list.title: 3. Native Bikram Sambat (वि.सं.) Calendar & Ledger
list.summary: Manage your farm ledger according to the official calendar of Nepal. No mental conversion between English and Nepali months.
bullet_points: Custom offline Bikram Sambat date picker covering past, present, and future agricultural seasons
Worker ledger automatically groups entries chronologically by Nepali year and month (Baisakh through Chaitra)
Dual BS and AD date display across all transaction lists and preview dialogs
Bilingual Devanagari numerals and Nepali day/month formatting

list.title: 4. Worker Profiles & Date-Effective Rate Overrides
list.summary: Easily register workers with name, phone number, address, and opening balance carried forward from previous paper registers.
bullet_points: Set universal default wage rates per task (e.g. Tea Picking: रू 28/kg, Plowing: रू 850/day)
Configure worker-specific rate overrides with custom start and end date validity windows
Senior workers or specialized equipment operators can receive custom rates automatically on entry
Soft-archival: deactivate seasonal workers without losing a single historical record

list.title: 5. Historical Rate Immutability & Audited Voids
list.summary: Financial history must remain honest. If you change a task's default rate tomorrow, past work entries are never recomputed or distorted.
bullet_points: Rate and calculated earnings are stamped permanently at the moment of entry creation
Silent deletion is strictly prevented: erroneous entries are marked with status `voided` with a mandatory reason
Every voided record appends an immutable `AuditEvent` capturing complete before-and-after JSON snapshots
Workers with financial history are permanently protected against accidental deletion

list.title: 6. Professional A4 PDF Worker Statements
list.summary: Generate clean, official, printable PDF account statements for any worker with a single tap.
bullet_points: Formatted specifically for standard A4 printing and digital sharing via WhatsApp or Viber
Engineered with 25-row chunking to effortlessly handle multi-month ledgers without memory crashes
Displays full itemized breakdown: dates (BS/AD), task names, rates, quantities, advances, and running balances
Includes explicit read-only disclaimer to avoid confusion regarding settlement status

list.title: 7. Twice-Daily Offline Field Reminders
list.summary: Farm work is exhausting. At the end of a long day in the field, it is easy to postpone bookkeeping until tomorrow—leading to forgotten entries.
bullet_points: Configured for 5:00 PM (end of field shift) and 8:00 PM (post-dinner review)
100% offline local notifications: triggers reliably without internet or cell service
Polite reminder messages in Nepali asking to verify today's khetala entries
Can be easily toggled on or off from the Settings screen

list.title: 8. Cloud Synchronization & Multi-Device Continuity
list.summary: Cloud-backed agricultural accounting with Cloud Firestore. Automatically synchronizes pending records when connected, during data mutations, or upon manual trigger, providing seamless multi-device continuity.
bullet_points: Access synchronized household records after signing in to the same account on another phone, reducing the risk of record loss when a phone is lost, damaged, or upgraded
Automatic background sync triggers on network reconnect, record mutation, or manual sync
Strict household data isolation under `/households/{householdId}` with end-to-end security rules
Side-by-side visual conflict resolution at `/conflicts` ensures zero ambiguous record overwrites

how_it_works.description: Getting started takes less than two minutes. No complex accounting knowledge or training required.

steps.title: Add Workers & Set Task Rates

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Direct, factual answers regarding offline functionality, financial calculations, data backup, and privacy.

items.q: Does Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab work without an internet connection?
items.a: Yes. Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab is built with a local-first architecture using Drift SQLite. All core daily features—including logging worker attendance, calculating tea harvest wages by weight, recording cash advances, and calculating running balances—work completely offline in remote fields without cellular signal or Wi-Fi. Pending entries are safely stored locally and synchronized to the cloud when connectivity returns.

items.q: Is the app completely free to use? Are there hidden fees or subscriptions?
items.a: Yes, Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab is completely free to download and use. There are no monthly subscriptions, no locked features, no paid tiers, and zero third-party advertisements.

items.q: What happens if my phone is lost, broken, or upgraded?
items.a: Because Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab is cloud-backed, your synchronized household records remain safe in Cloud Firestore. Simply sign in to the same account on your new Android phone, and the app will discover and restore your complete farm household ledger. Additionally, you can export offline JSON backup files with SHA-256 checksums at any time for secondary local archiving.

items.q: How does the app handle fractional work, such as tea picking in kilograms or half-day labor?
items.a: The app natively supports fractional quantities. When recording tea harvesting, you can enter exact weights such as 18.75 kg. For daily labor, you can choose 'Partial Day' and enter 0.5. The engine multiplies the quantity by the applicable rate using integer paisa BigInt arithmetic and rounds half-up to the nearest paisa.

items.q: What is 'Paisa Accuracy' and why does it matter?
items.a: Standard computer spreadsheets and calculator apps use floating-point numbers (`double`), which accumulate subtle binary rounding errors (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004). Over hundreds of daily entries, this creates discrepancies between paper registers and digital totals. Digital Khetala stores all money as exact integers in paisa (1 NPR = 100 paisa), eliminating math errors entirely.

items.q: Can I use the Nepali Bikram Sambat (वि.सं.) calendar?
items.a: Yes. Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab features a native offline Bikram Sambat date picker. Your entire worker ledger is chronologically grouped by Nepali agricultural months (Baisakh, Jestha, Ashadh, etc.), matching exactly how farm labor and festival pay cycles operate in Nepal.

items.q: What if I make a mistake when entering a payment or work entry? Can I delete it?
items.a: To preserve financial honesty and prevent covert tampering, the app uses 'Audited Voids' instead of silent deletion. When you void an entry, you must supply a reason (e.g. 'Duplicate entry'). The record is marked void, its amount is immediately removed from the worker's balance, and a permanent before-and-after snapshot is recorded in the system audit log.

items.q: Can multiple family members access farm accounts across different phones?
items.a: Yes. When family members sign in to the same household account across multiple devices, Cloud Firestore keeps records continuously synchronized. Daily field entries logged on one phone sync seamlessly to others upon connection. If a record is edited on two devices at once, the built-in conflict resolution screen at `/conflicts` lets you review changes side-by-side.

items.q: How can I back up my data without using the internet?
items.a: In the Settings screen, you can tap 'Export Backup' at any time. The app generates an encrypted, human-readable JSON backup file stamped with a SHA-256 checksum and saves it to your phone's storage. You can transfer this file to an SD card, a computer, or send it to your email.

items.q: Is my farm's financial data private and secure?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. Your farm accounting records are strictly partitioned under your unique household account in Cloud Firestore (`/households/{householdId}/*`). Firestore security rules ensure that only authenticated members of your household can access your records. We never sell, monetize, track, or share your worker wages or crop yields with advertisers or third parties.

items.q: How do I share a wage statement with a worker?
items.a: Open the worker's profile, select 'Generate Statement (PDF)', choose the date range (e.g. this month or all-time), and preview the statement. You can tap 'Share' to send the PDF directly to the worker via WhatsApp or Bluetooth, or connect to any wireless printer for physical paper copies.

items.q: Why does Android warn that the file 'might be harmful' when I download the APK?
items.a: Android displays this generic security warning for any application downloaded directly from a web browser instead of the Google Play Store. It is a standard operating system notice. Our APK is 100% clean, built with official Android SDKs, and contains no malicious code or trackers.

items.q: Can I set different daily wage rates for different workers?
items.a: Yes. While each task has a default rate (e.g. Daily Labor at रू 800), you can configure 'Rate Overrides' for specific workers. For instance, a tractor driver or senior worker can be assigned रू 1,000/day, which will automatically apply whenever you record work for them.

items.q: If I update a crop rate midway through the season, will past records change?
items.a: No. The application enforces historical rate immutability. When you record a work entry, the applicable rate and computed earnings are stamped permanently onto that entry. Updating default rates tomorrow will only apply to future work entries.

about.title: Created for the Hardworking Agricultural Community of Nepal
about.subtitle: Born in the tea-growing heartland of Eastern Nepal to protect farm owners and daily laborers from record loss and bitter wage disputes.
about.story_p1: In Nepal's agricultural belt—from the emerald tea gardens of Jhapa, Ilam, and Panchthar to the terraced potato and maize fields of the mid-hills—farm labor management has relied on the same fragile tool for over half a century: pocket-sized paper registers (खता/कापी).
about.story_p2: Every monsoon season brings the same recurring hardship. Heavy downpours soak notebooks in the field. Pages smudge with mud or tear apart during transport. Worse still, cash advances (पेश्की) handed to workers before major festivals like Dashain and Tihar are often jotted down on loose corners. When settlement day arrives months later, misplaced notes spark painful disagreements between families who have worked together for generations.
about.story_p3: Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab was engineered by Saurav Karki, a software engineer born and raised in Birtamode, Jhapa. Having witnessed these exact struggles firsthand among local tea growers and agricultural families, Saurav set out to build a tool that truly respects the realities of rural Nepal.
about.story_p4: This is not an overcomplicated Silicon Valley SaaS app that requires fast 5G data or credit cards. It is an honest, cloud-backed agricultural ledger with offline functionality: fully operational in remote fields without cellular coverage, calculating to the exact paisa, speaking fluent Nepali in Bikram Sambat (वि.सं.), and keeping family farm records secure across devices.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy for Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab
privacy.intro: Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab is developed by Saurav Karki as a cloud-backed agricultural utility with offline functionality. This Privacy Policy discloses our strict principles regarding the collection, storage, and handling of your farm financial data.

sections.title: 1. Local-First & Cloud-Backed Architecture
sections.content: Digital Khetala Hisab-Kitab is designed to operate seamlessly in remote fields without cellular network. All information you enter—including worker names, telephone numbers, addresses, daily labor entries, harvested weights, wage rates, advance payments, and notes—is stored first on your device in an encrypted SQLite database via Drift ORM. When internet connectivity is available, records synchronize with Google Cloud Firestore under your private household account.

sections.title: 2. Cloud Synchronization & Multi-Device Continuity
sections.content: When signed in with Google Sign-In or Email authentication, your records synchronize with Google Cloud Firestore under a strictly isolated household path (`/households/{householdId}/*`). Synchronization enables multi-device continuity within your own household, allowing you to access records if a phone is lost, broken, or upgraded. Your records are protected by Firestore security rules that strictly prevent any unauthorized user from reading or modifying your data.

sections.title: 3. Data We Do NOT Collect
sections.content: We believe farm financial records are deeply private. We do NOT: 1) Sell, rent, or monetize your personal or financial data to advertisers, lenders, or data brokers; 2) Display third-party commercial advertisements; 3) Track your physical GPS location; 4) Inspect, aggregate, or profile individual crop yields or wage rates.

sections.title: 4. Device Permissions Requested
sections.content: The application requests only two standard Android permissions: 1) `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`: To deliver your chosen twice-daily reminder prompts at 5:00 PM and 8:00 PM. These notifications are scheduled locally on your device without any external push notification server. 2) Storage Access: To allow your phone to save exported A4 PDF statements and encrypted JSON backup files to your Downloads or Documents directory.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention & Deletion
sections.content: You retain 100% control over your data. You can delete individual records via audited voiding, clear your local database in the app settings, or export your entire history as a JSON backup at any time. If you use cloud sync and wish to permanently delete your cloud household account, you may submit a request to `sauravkarki279@gmail.com` and all associated Firestore records will be permanently purged within 7 business days.

sections.title: 6. Contact Information
sections.content: If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy or data security practices, contact: Saurav Karki, Birtamode, Jhapa, Koshi Province, Nepal. Email: sauravkarki279@gmail.com.
